capabilities: Open .limn files as interactive mind map views
Edit Markdown bullet-list notes as mind maps and write changes back to the note
Create, reorder, indent, and reparent nodes with keyboard shortcuts
Copy and paste branches as Markdown bullet lists and images as embeds
Render inline markdown (bold, italic, code, links) in node text
extras: Also distributed as a standalone offline-capable progressive web app (tednaleid.github.io/limn) storing documents in browser IndexedDB; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Markdown map view drops node layout (positions, colors) and rewrites list formatting on first edit, which can append backslashes that break inline Dataview/Tasks fields on continuation lines.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated mind mapping view, so outlines can only be edited as text without spatial node layout or keyboard-driven map navigation.

relations.evidence: If you want the latest unreleased build, install via BRAT instead

summary: Keyboard-first mind map editor that opens .limn files and Markdown bullet-list notes as interactive SVG mind map views.
